title: L¹ norm on a ball is bounded by testing against C¹ functions (bounded integrands)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, R, A, M ∈ ℝ, and let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ be Borel with |f(z)| ≤ M for all z. Suppose ∫ f φ dL ≤ A for every C¹ function φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support, tsupport φ ⊆ B_R(0) and |φ(z)| ≤ 1 for all z. Then ∫_{B_R(0)} |f| dL ≤ A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (R A M : ℝ), Measurable f → (∀ z, |f z| ≤ M) → (∀ φ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R → (∀ z, |φ z| ≤ 1) → ∫ z, f z * φ z ≤ A) → ∫ z in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, |f z| ≤ A
